submitted.rationale: Of the 5 measured compositions, index 24 (Sb 0.82) gave the highest EQE, 0.0172%. EQE is low near the CoSb2O6 trirutile composition (0.67 → 0.0015%) and rises in the Sb-rich region: 0.0172% at 0.82 and 0.0163% at 0.86. This points to an optimum around 0.8–0.85. The Co-rich side is poor.
